He thought about the hand that wrote those words, whether it still existed, and whether the message had been meant for anyone in particular or just for the dark.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像是被按下了静音键。路灯还亮着，光晕里飘着细小的雾气，street空无一人，只有便利店的玻璃窗透出一点冷白的光。远处偶尔驶过一辆出租车，车灯划破寂静，又很快消失在拐角。高楼的轮廓模糊地立在天边，大多数窗户都黑着，只有几户还亮着灯，像是谁也没睡。风从巷子口吹过，带着一点凉意和隔夜的饭菜味。清洁工推着车，扫帚划过地面的声音格外清晰。整座城市仿佛在喘息，积蓄着力气，等待着天亮后重新喧闹起来。", "w03": "Recursion is when a function solves a big problem by calling itself to solve a smaller version of the same problem.\nEach time it calls itself, the problem gets a little smaller, like opening nested boxes until you find the smallest one.\nThere has to be a stopping point, called the base case, or the function would keep calling itself forever."}
